faqs.a:
The city manager shall be authorized to evaluate and analyze those situations, facts,
               or circumstances that occur with respect to the application of this article that are
               not specifically addressed by the procedure and criteria of this article. Decisions
               and determinations with respect to procedures necessary to give effect to this article
               that are not otherwise addressed by this article, shall be subject to the provisions
               of
section 2-141
et seq., "Administrative Rule Making." The city manager shall be authorized to promulgate
               such administrative rules pursuant thereto.
(Code 1981, § 27-223; Ord. No. 3717, § 1, 8-27-2001)
